title: What time is it?
grammar: quarter past / half past / quarter to

scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: The expedition timetable is strict, Diego! Breakfast at quarter past seven — and you're LATE again!
scene.intro: The expedition timetable is strict, Diego! Breakfast at quarter past seven, not half past. We leave at quarter to eight. The museum opens at midday and closes at midnight — no, that can't be right, says Ingrid, checking again. Diego is always five minutes late and always has a good reason. Are you early or late? Look at the clock and say the exact time!

data.script: Ingrid: Listen carefully, Diego. Breakfast is at quarter past seven. … Diego: Quarter past seven, got it. … Ingrid: The boat leaves at half past eight — if you're late, you swim! … Diego: Ha! And when do we reach the island? … Ingrid: At midday, if the sea is calm. … Diego: When is the picnic? … Ingrid: At one o'clock, on the beach. … Diego: And the trip home? … Ingrid: We sail back at quarter to five. Set your alarm! … Diego: Don't worry, captain. I'll set two alarms!
